description:
Functional specifications / files: add lib/zaq/channels/delivery/executor.ex with a cohesive orchestration responsibility, using contracts/preparation above and existing Zaq.TaskSupervisor. Validate graph/indices before effects. Abort publishes sequentially and stops on failure retaining prior confirmations. Continue promotes next eligible root with original answer after an unconfirmed root, never retries the failed operation, then runs ready threaded replies concurrently; independent messages need no root. Configurable concurrency default 4 per attempt; reports remain in plan order. Per upload/send/edit supervised timeout defaults to 30,000ms; task exit/timeout is unconfirmed, not rejected. Preserve uploaded-only and unattempted facts.
Tests before implementation: reference executor/group execution matrix ported to separate Plan/Outgoing; confirmed-root promotion, one invocation per step, no repeated failed edit, bounded concurrency, sequential abort, sole-send/edit/upload deadlines, task exits, stable result order and original indices. Property tests for dependency ordering and no duplicate invocation. Preparation continue text fallback retains failure evidence.
Branches: both placements/modes/policies, partial uploads, blocked dependency, all candidates uncertain, existing streamed edit, no confirmations.
Mocking: controllable external operation boundary only; real runtime/preparation; injected config/dependencies resolved once. No globals/sleep synchronization.
Documentation: executor module contract and Channels guide.
Action reuse: local-only Channel infrastructure over existing bridges/preparation; no new send Action or provider-specific executor. Safe normalized results consumed by DeliveryConfirmation/Engine; transport calls at most once per step, not global idempotency across separate caller submissions.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

comments.text:
Executor contract before implementation: execute(outgoing, plan, bridge, selected_connection, opts) returns {:ok, Result} when any publication confirms, {:error, Error, Result} when none confirms, and {:error, Error} for invalid preflight inputs before effects. Reuse Preparation attempt state and Plan validation. Resolve :channel_delivery config once via Zaq.Config; defaults step_timeout_ms 30000/max_concurrency 4, per-call overrides and existing Zaq.TaskSupervisor. No reporting inside runtime; existing DeliveryConfirmation integration remains .7.
Bridge optional execute_delivery_step/3 consumes one validated Step and inputs containing current Outgoing, indexed attachments (raw files for direct sends, index/reference maps after uploads), exact prepared payload, and continuation flag. Upload returns {:ok, %{uploaded_refs: %{original_index => actual provider ID}}} or {:error, Error, %{uploaded_refs: partial_refs}}; publication returns normalized confirmed receipt with message_id or typed Error. Unknown/malformed success stays unconfirmed. Never retry provider operations.
Use Task.Supervisor.async_stream_nolink with unordered results, bounded concurrency, kill-on-timeout and exit input attribution; fold outcomes into an ID map and build Result in plan order. Catch provider exceptions privately; timeout/exit unconfirmed. Abort acquires/prepares required direct requests or completes uploads before any publication, then publishes sequentially. Continue promotes threaded roots sequentially until confirmation, then runs ready replies concurrently; independent groups do not wait for a root. Empty failed groups prefer later usable files, or one text-only original answer if none survive. Continuation body follows reference Additional files (ordinal/total); preserve original answer for root promotion. Re-encode actual body/thread headers before each publication and recheck size. Upload byte state releases per completed upload; direct state releases per publication.
Validate phase compatibility before effects: uploads cannot depend on publication, because approved abort requires all uploads before publication. Other acyclic upload/pub dependencies respect readiness. Partial upload facts preserve usable provider IDs and missing-file failure evidence; no uploaded ID alone confirms publication. Configuration-resolution fallback remains no-acquisition/no-upload and uses only explicitly supplied valid text transport constraints; real bridge text compatibility is .5. Tests cover sequencing, promotion/edit, bounded concurrency, deadlines including sole operations, partial uploads, no duplicates, original-index ordering, invalid metadata/dependencies, and no publication on abort preparation failure.

Executor implemented and validated. Uploads/send/edit run at most once under existing TaskSupervisor with 30s default deadlines and concurrency 4, configurable through one Zaq.Config boundary. Unordered worker completion maps to plan-ordered Result; timeout/exit stays unconfirmed. Abort completes required uploads/direct preparation before sequential publication and stops retaining confirmations. Continue promotes threaded roots with original answer, overlaps ready replies, retains partial upload IDs and only missing-file evidence, and emits at most one text fallback when no files survive. Raw bytes/payloads release per consumer; original-answer group identity remains metadata after release. Exact changed-header encodings rechecked before effects. Invalid graphs/unsupported upload-after-publication dependencies fail before acquisition. Shared FileSettings.failure_policy extracted and reused by resolver and no-file fallback; explicit false aborts. Requirements-error continuation needs explicit valid max_text_request_bytes and never acquires/uploads files. Optional unresolved facts accepted. No bridge resolver, Outgoing wrapper, new Action/tool, reporter/persistence duplication or production route integration.
Validation: TDD red and targeted regressions for dependency blocking, stale continuation identity after release, partial IDs, malformed provider facts, direct abort preflight, sole send/edit/upload and post-root reply deadlines, root promotion, uncertain edit no retry, bounded concurrency/progress, exact header growth, no-file fallback, literal policy. Final focused suites passed 124 cases (12 properties); final mix q passed, including format/hooks/Credo/docs/compile. Four local complexity findings split into cohesive private helpers. Existing tests retain behavior; Mattermost behavior approval recorded separately .13 (closed). Final precommit/review/coverage and feature E2E remain later lifecycle gates. No commits, pushes, merges or dependency publication.
